meta.value:
"""Final pressure moments v2: keep B1-B3 and W1-W3 (s22), replace B4, B5, W4, W5 with the two bowling gaps the full
audit (s25) confirmed: new W4 = left-handed No. 3-4 in overs 7-15, new W5 = right-arm pace to right-handed openers in
overs 1-6. Stats for the new two use s25's checks (champion luck draws, RR match resampling); plain numbers and player
lists use the same rules as s22. Also writes the dashboard JSONs for moments, players and the step-2 top lists."""
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, json, pathlib
W = "/home/claude/work/"
src = open("/home/claude/scripts/s25_grid.py").read(); ns = {}; exec(src[:src.index("rows = []")], ns)
b, evaluate = ns["b"], ns["evaluate"]
champ = ns["champ"]; b["bnd"] = b.is_four | b.is_six
M = pd.read_csv(W + "final_moments.csv"); PL = pd.read_csv(W + "final_moment_players.csv")
M = M[M.id.isin(["B1", "B2", "B3", "W1", "W2", "W3"])]; PL = PL[PL.id.isin(M.id)]
ov = b.legal_before // 6
NEW = [("W4", "Left-handed No. 3-4 in the middle overs", "Bowling to left-handed batters at No. 3-4 in overs 7-15.",
        "A middle-overs bowler who troubles left-handers (off-spin or left-arm wrist spin)", (ov.between(6, 14)) & (b.batting_order.between(3, 4)) & (b.batting_type == "LHB")),
       ("W5", "New ball to right-handed openers", "Right-arm pace bowling to right-handed openers in overs 1-6.",
        "A new-ball pace bowler who takes early wickets", (ov <= 5) & (b.batting_order <= 2) & (b.batting_type == "RHB") & (b.btype == "Right-arm pace"))]
def plain(s):
    L = s[s.legal | s.is_wide | s.is_nb]; lb = L.legal.sum()
    return {"economy": 6 * L.bowler_runs.sum() / lb, "balls_per_wicket": lb / max(L.bowler_wkt.sum(), 1), "dot_pct": 100 * L[L.legal].isdot.mean(), "boundary_pct": 100 * L[L.legal].bnd.mean(), "balls": int(lb)}
RETIRED = {"Ravichandran Ashwin", "Ajinkya Rahane", "Andre Russell"}
active = set(b[b.year >= 2025].bowler_id)
sq = pd.read_csv(W + "squads2026.csv"); RR26 = set(sq[sq.team_name == "Rajasthan Royals"].player_name)
rows, players = [], []
for mid, short, desc, need, mask in NEW:
    r = evaluate(mask, "bowling"); s = b[mask.values]
    rr = s[(s.bowling_team_id == 3) & (s.year >= 2025)]; ch = s[[(y, t) in champ for y, t in zip(s.year, s.bowling_team_id)]]
    row = {"id": mid, "side": "Bowling", "moment": short, "definition": desc, "points_to": need,
           "rr_wins_lost_per_season": round(r["rr_raw_wins"], 2), "champ_wins_gained_per_season": round(r["champ_wins"], 2),
           "luck_chance_pct": round(100 * r["luck_p"], 1), "rr_shortfall_real_pct": round(100 * r["p_rr_below"]), "rr_balls": int(r["rr_balls"]),
           "balls_per_team_season": int(round(r["bpy"]))}
    for pre, q in (("rr_", rr), ("champ_", ch), ("league_", s)):
        for k, v in plain(q).items():
            if pre == "rr_" and k == "balls": continue
            row[pre + k] = round(v, 1)
    rows.append(row)
    q = s[s.year >= 2023]
    g = q.groupby("bowler_id").agg(name=("bowler_name", "first"), balls=("wpa", "size"), wpa=("wpa", "sum"))
    g["value_per_10"] = -10 * g.wpa / (g.balls + 40); g = g[g.index.isin(active) & ~g.name.isin(RETIRED)]
    for kind, sub in (("best", g[(g.balls >= 25) & (g.value_per_10 > 0)].sort_values("value_per_10", ascending=False).head(8)), ("rr", g[g.name.isin(RR26)].sort_values("balls", ascending=False).head(6))):
        for p, pr in sub.iterrows():
            pp = plain(q[q.bowler_id == p])
            players.append({"id": mid, "list": "Best in the league" if kind == "best" else "RR's 2026 squad", "name": pr["name"], "balls": int(pr.balls),
                            "value_per_10_balls": round(pr.value_per_10, 2), "key_stat": round(pp["economy"], 1), "key_label": "Economy"})
M2 = pd.concat([M, pd.DataFrame(rows)], ignore_index=True); PL2 = pd.concat([PL, pd.DataFrame(players)], ignore_index=True)
M2.to_csv(W + "final_moments_v2.csv", index=False); PL2.to_csv(W + "final_moment_players_v2.csv", index=False)
pd.set_option("display.width", 300)
print(M2[["id", "moment", "rr_wins_lost_per_season", "champ_wins_gained_per_season", "luck_chance_pct", "rr_shortfall_real_pct", "rr_balls", "rr_economy", "champ_economy", "league_economy", "rr_balls_per_wicket", "league_balls_per_wicket"]].to_string(index=False))
print(PL2[PL2.id.isin(["W4", "W5"])].to_string(index=False))
# dashboard JSONs
O = pathlib.Path("/home/claude/dash6"); O.mkdir(exist_ok=True); CODE = pathlib.Path(__file__).read_text()
def dump(name, df, inputs):
    rws = json.loads(df.replace({np.nan: None}).to_json(orient="records"))
    (O / f"{name}.json").write_text(json.dumps({"rows": rws, "meta": [{"label": "s29_moments_v2.py", "value": CODE, "type": "code", "lang": "python"}, {"label": "Input", "value": inputs}]}))
    print(name, len(rws))
dump("moments", M2, "final_moments_v2.csv (s22 for B1-B3, W1-W3; s25 checks for W4, W5)")
dump("moment_players", PL2, "final_moment_players_v2.csv: IPL 2023-26, any team")
EXCL = {"Harry Brook", "Andre Russell", "Ajinkya Rahane", "Ravichandran Ashwin"}
for kind in ["bat", "bowl"]:
    n = pd.read_csv(W + f"fin2_ratings_{kind}.csv", index_col=0); n = n[(n.last_team != "Pakistan") & ~n.name.isin(EXCL)].copy(); n["rank"] = np.arange(1, len(n) + 1)
    n["top10_in_resamples_pct"] = (100 * n.boot_top10).round(0); n["team"] = n.ipl_team_latest.fillna("No IPL team")
    cols = ["rank", "name", "team", "pb", "top10_in_resamples_pct"] + (["SR_P", "SR_N"] if kind == "bat" else ["Econ_P", "Econ_N"])
    dump(f"top_{kind}", n[cols].head(15).round(1), f"fin2_ratings_{kind}.csv (s30_unified_v2.py)")
